A NEW BEGINNING
Bring your page into the light.
Paste a self-contained HTML page or choose a file. Your content stays in this browser. Scripts, embedded pages and remote resources are excluded from the preview and export.
Up to 500 KB


What the light reaches.
Ghostlight checks eight focused categories: page language, page title, image alternatives, control labels, button names, link names, heading order and text contrast on supported solid backgrounds.
It does not certify WCAG conformance. A passing automated check does not prove that text is meaningful, a journey is usable, or the full page is accessible. Color checks skip conditions they cannot reliably resolve.
The preview and exported page are sanitized static HTML. JavaScript, nested frames, external styles and remote resources are intentionally excluded. Navigation and submissions are disabled in the preview.
